evidence.description: Starting a replacement cancels the previous task, but both success and failure paths remove the URL entry without checking which task currently occupies it.

candidates.explanation: A canceled task can resume from its suspended download after a replacement has been stored under the same URL. Its cleanup then removes the replacement's entry from activeTasks. Main-actor isolation does not prevent this interleaving across await, leaving an active replacement untracked.
candidates.title: Obsolete tasks can remove replacement task tracking

evidence.description: Cancellation enumerates and cancels every task in the injected session, independently of activeTasks.
URL-specific cancellation also searches session-wide tasks rather than restricting cancellation to the tracked task.

candidates.explanation: The session-wide cancellation operations are not limited to tasks created by this Images instance. If the injected session contains other work, cancellAll cancels that work too, and cancel can cancel another request matching the URL. The asynchronous enumeration also is not tied to the set of tasks tracked when cancellation was requested.
candidates.title: Cancellation extends beyond the loader's tracked work

evidence.description: The response is discarded, and returned data is immediately published and cached.

candidates.explanation: URLSession.data(from:) can return normally for HTTP error status codes. Because the response is ignored, an HTTP error body can be published as an Item and cached under the requested URL. Subsequent loads then use that cached body rather than making another request.
candidates.title: HTTP error responses are treated as successful images

evidence.description: The catch block handles all errors solely by removing task tracking.

candidates.explanation: All download errors are swallowed without reporting or recording the failure, and cancellation is treated identically to other errors. Failed loads therefore produce neither an item nor any visible failure signal from this code, obscuring the reason a load did not complete.
candidates.title: Download failures are silently discarded

evidence.description: The instance retains downloaded items in a set containing their Data.
Every successful download inserts an item into the retained set.
Each retained item includes the complete downloaded data.

candidates.explanation: Each successfully loaded distinct URL adds its complete data to items, and the class provides no removal, clearing, or eviction path. Memory retained by a long-lived instance therefore grows with its successful unique loads, including after cancellation operations.
candidates.title: Image cache grows without any eviction mechanism
